purpose: Pinned interpreter for the Resolve bridge. fusionscript.dll in Resolve 21.0.4.5 binds cleanly ONLY against CPython 3.12.x (measured 2026-08-23 on one Windows machine: 3.12.10 works; 3.11.9 and 3.14.7 crash 0xC0000005 in PyInit_fusionscript). The pin is the crash fix; it is exact by design, not staleness. Re-measure before changing on any Resolve upgrade.
distribution: python.org embeddable (no installer, no registry, per-tree)
install: expand the zip to python312/ next to the bridge scripts, then copy the versioned python312._pth from this directory over python312/python312._pth (the '..' line puts the bridge directory on sys.path; the embeddable build is isolated and ignores PYTHONPATH/script dir). deploy.ps1 automates both.
